It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/109517370/profile MRePotatoes]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} Rat.gif|First version (5 August 2019 – 29 October 2020) }} ==Trivia== *This was based on the Instagram video [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/oh-shit-a-rat Oh Shit, a Rat]. **The [[Emotes|emote]] audio used the same audio from the video, with the expletive cut out. *This was the first emote to spawn a mesh. **The rat spawned by the '''Rat''' emote is the {{RLinkC|21070037|Louie}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Original Music Lyrics== ''Oh-, a rat!'' ==Update History== *'''5 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.8|BETA v1.8.0]] **'''Rat''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation replaced. **Music removed. {{EmoteNavBox}}
